annotations.title: Edit a workbook in the shell

description: Writes the workbook into your shell session's /tmp to edit with bash; with `commit`, reads the checkout back and saves it as a new version.

base_version.description: With `commit`: the version the checkout reported.

commit.description: true to save the checkout as a new version.

note.description: With `commit`: one line on what changed.

session.description: Optional: another shell's id, what `session id` prints inside it. Omit for this connection's shell.
